title: Disrupting the MC1R/alpha-MSH-pCREB-MITF Axis: Rhein-based PROTAC D16 as a Potent Melanogenesis Inhibitor.
authors: Xu, Meng; Zhang, Ziqing; Zhang, Peixi; He, Xinyi; Zeng, Huagong; Chen, Ming; Wang, Yan; Xia, Yuanxi; Lu, Weiming; Huang, Shi; Luo, Shien; Huang, Yueping; Chen, Muge; Ma, Junjie; Liu, Jieqing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Rhein-based PROTAC D16通过降解pCREB抑制黑色素生成，涉及蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与课题无关。
abstract: Melanin protects skin from ultraviolet rays, but excessive or misdistributed synthesis can cause issues like melasma, freckles, or melanoma. Rhein from traditional Chinese herbs shows various bioactivities, with recent structural modifications enhancing its derivatives, but its effect on melanogenesis is unreported. The study reports synthesizing and evaluating D16, Rhein-based proteolysis targeting chimera (PROTACs) utilizing pomalidomide as an E3 ligand. D16 exhibited significantly reduced cytotoxicity, with half-maximal inhibitory concentration values exceeding 100 microM in both B16-F10 melanoma and human immortalized keratinocyte cells, indicating a low level of toxicity. In addition, mechanistic studies revealed that D16 suppresses melanin production primarily through the melanocortin 1 receptor/alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone signaling pathway, with further analysis suggesting phosphorylated cyclic adenosine monophosphate-response element binding protein (pCREB) as a key target. Through pCREB degradation, D16 disrupts microphthalmia-associated transcription factor transcription, leading to reduced levels of tyrosine. Molecular docking studies further confirmed strong binding between D16 and pCREB. Animal experiment results indicated that D16 effectively suppressed melanogenesis in mice. These findings underscore the potential of D16 to treat melanin-related disorders by targeting pCREB, advancing both the therapeutic utility of PROTACs and the application of pCREB modulation in pigmentation treatments.
abstract_zh: 黑色素保护皮肤免受紫外线伤害，但过量或分布不均的合成可能导致黄褐斑、雀斑或黑色素瘤等问题。来自传统中草药的大黄酸显示出多种生物活性，近年来的结构修饰增强了其衍生物的性能，但其对黑色素生成的影响尚未见报道。本研究报道了合成并评估D16，一种基于大黄酸的蛋白降解靶向嵌合体（PROTACs），利用泊马度胺作为E3配体。D16表现出显著降低的细胞毒性，在B16-F10黑色素瘤细胞和人永生化角质形成细胞中的半数抑制浓度值均超过100微摩尔，表明其毒性水平较低。此外，机制研究表明，D16主要通过黑皮质素1受体/α-黑色素细胞刺激激素信号通路抑制黑色素产生，进一步分析提示磷酸化环磷酸腺苷反应元件结合蛋白（pCREB）为关键靶点。通过pCREB降解，D16干扰小眼畸形相关转录因子的转录，导致酪氨酸水平降低。分子对接研究进一步证实了D16与pCREB之间的强结合。动物实验结果表明，D16有效抑制了小鼠体内的黑色素生成。这些发现强调了D16通过靶向pCREB治疗黑色素相关疾病的潜力，推进了PROTACs的治疗应用及pCREB调控在色素沉着治疗中的实践。
